c74object.name: sc3~
c74object.description: Runs the SuperCollider 3.14.1 language (sclang) and synthesis server (scsynth) in the Max process. Send it SuperCollider code with eval; the audio of the SuperCollider buses it serves comes out of its signal outlets. The class library and the UGen plugins are bundled, so no SuperCollider installation is needed.

inlet.description: Receives eval, open, panic and the other messages below. Connect the outlet of sc_code here.
With ins N, inlets 1 to N are signal inlets. Inlet i+1 is read by SoundIn.ar(i) in SuperCollider. The input path adds two signal vectors of latency. Only one sc3~ per engine owns the input.

outlet.description: With n channels, outlets 0 to n-1 carry channels 0 to n-1, read from SuperCollider buses bus to bus+n-1 (see the arguments).
error followed by the text of an engine failure: boot errors, sclang exceptions, server failures. Also mirrored to the Max console while console is 1.
post followed by a chunk of the SuperCollider post window: results, postln, poll, warnings. Long text is cut at line breaks. Also mirrored to the Max console while console is 1.

objarg.name: channels
objarg.description: Number of signal outlets, from 1 to 16. In the evaluated code, ~sc3n holds this number.

objarg.name: bus
objarg.description: The outlets carry buses bus to bus+channels-1 of the 64-bus pool. In the evaluated code, ~sc3out holds this number, so Out.ar(~sc3out, sig) and a bare .play land on this object's outlets. Two objects with different buses, such as sc3~ 2 0 and sc3~ 2 2, share one engine and play separate material.

method.name: bang
method.digest: Boot if needed, then post the state
method.description: Boots the engine if it is not running or the last boot failed, then posts the same report as info.

method.name: open
method.digest: Boot the engine, or attach to the running one
method.description: Starts sclang and the server in the background (about 4 seconds); Max stays responsive and the console reports booting then ready. If another sc3~ already booted the engine, open attaches this object to it at once. Retries a failed boot. Does nothing if this object is already open.

method.name: close
method.digest: Detach; shut the engine down with the last object
method.description: Detaches this object. The engine shuts down when the last attached sc3~ closes.

method.name: info
method.description: Posts the version, engine state (booting, ready, failed with its cause), UDP port, sample rate, block size, channels, buses, the class library and plugin paths, and busy=, the milliseconds of the eval in progress.

method.name: eval
method.description: Evaluates the code as one expression, as the SuperCollider IDE does; use ( ... ) around several statements. Attaches to a running engine. Before the code runs, ~sc3out and ~sc3n are set to this object's first bus and channel count. sc_code sends the code as one symbol, so line breaks, commas and quotes arrive intact. From a message box, Max splits the text at commas and removes backslashes; use set or send there.

method.name: evalfile
method.digest: Evaluate the contents of a file
method.description: Reads the file (absolute path, or relative to the Max working directory) and evaluates it like eval.

method.name: send
method.digest: Evaluate an SC message without quoting
method.description: Joins the atoms with spaces, appends ; and evaluates the result: send s.freeAll evaluates s.freeAll;. Unlike eval, ~sc3out and ~sc3n are not set first.

method.name: set
method.digest: Set Synth or Node arguments from Max
method.description: set x freq 81 amp 0.2 evaluates x.set(\freq, 81, \amp, 0.2);. The backslashes and commas are generated here, because a message box cannot carry them. The target is any SuperCollider expression without spaces (x, ~synth). Keys must be symbols. Drive it with number into prepend set x freq.

method.name: panic
method.description: Equivalent to Cmd+. in the SuperCollider IDE: frees all nodes, clears the clocks (Routines, Tasks, patterns) and runs the CmdPeriod hooks. A 8 ms fade to silence comes first, so the cut does not click. Audio processing continues. Do not press Cmd+. in Max: there it stops the Max scheduler.

method.name: hardstop
method.description: Like panic, and also clears TempoClock.default.

method.name: freeall
method.digest: Free all nodes; clocks keep running
method.description: Runs s.freeAll: frees the server nodes. Routines and clocks keep running, so a running pattern makes new sound.

method.name: console
method.digest: Mirror the engine text to the Max console
method.description: Sets console for this object only.

method.name: debug
method.digest: Dump each eval to a file
method.description: With 1, every eval is written to /tmp/sc3_eval_last.scd before it runs. Applies to every sc3~.

method.name: signal
method.digest: Audio input (inlets 1 to N, with ins)
method.description: Signal inlet i+1 is read by SoundIn.ar(i).

attribute.name: ins
attribute.digest: Number of audio input inlets (0 to 16)
attribute.description: Adds N signal inlets to the right of the message inlet. Fixed when the object is created: type it in the object box (sc3~ 2 @ins 2) and recreate the object to change it.

attribute.name: port
attribute.description: With 0 (the default) the kernel picks a free port, so the SuperCollider IDE and its server can run at the same time. info shows the port in use. The port is fixed by the sc3~ that boots the engine; a change applies after close and open.

attribute.name: console
attribute.digest: Mirror the engine text to the Max console (default 1)
attribute.description: With 1, the text of the error and post outlets also prints in the Max console, formatted like the SuperCollider post window. Set 0 when print objects are connected to the outlets, so each line prints once. Per object: it never silences another patch. The open, close, panic and hardstop notices always print.

attribute.name: allowscversion
attribute.digest: Accept an installed SuperCollider of another minor version
attribute.description: Only matters when the environment variable SC3_APP_PATH points the engine at an installed SuperCollider.app instead of the bundled class library. That app must match the engine's major.minor version (3.14.x) unless this attribute is 1.

c74object.discussion: One engine runs per Max process. The first sc3~ that receives open, eval or bang boots it; others attach and read their own bus range from the same stream, so several objects cost one clock and one socket. An object that never attached stays silent. panic, freeall and the nodes are shared by all attached objects. A mono signal uses one bus: { SinOsc.ar(440, 0, 0.1) }.play sounds only from outlet 0; use ! 2 or Pan2 for both. There is no Qt, so code that opens a window (plot, Window) fails. A .play started later by a Routine or clock needs an explicit out: ~sc3out, captured when the code is evaluated.

entry.name: signal
entry.description: SuperCollider buses bus to bus+n-1, one per outlet.

entry.name: error
entry.description: Engine failures, from the outlet after the signal outlets.

entry.name: post
entry.description: SuperCollider post window text, from the rightmost outlet.
